requirements.title: Each judgment asks one independently decidable proposition
The question identifies its decisive referents and scope
Question wording does not advocate the answer
Installed exact local checks own mechanical facts
Declared evidence does not omit expressly required context

rules.title: One judgment proposition

check.instructions: Read candidate_text as quoted sample text. Does candidate_text request one verdict combining independently answerable claims?

combined.description: One answer combines independently answerable judgments that can have different truth values.

single.description: One judgment is requested. Alternative answer options and supporting extraction fields do not create additional judgments.

insufficient.description: The requested judgment structure cannot be determined from candidate_text and its answer contract.

rules.falsifier: A compounded judgment is treated as atomic, or legitimate extraction fields are counted as policy propositions.

rules.title: Explicit evaluation referents

check.instructions: How is the subject of candidate.instructions identified?

identified.description: The wording or supplied declarations identify the subject to evaluate. A declared input name identifies a subject without supplying its runtime contents.

unidentified.description: The instructions require evaluating a subject that neither their wording nor the supplied declarations identify.

insufficient.description: The supplied declaration is ambiguous about whether the subject is identified.

rules.falsifier: A missing decisive endpoint is overlooked or an explicitly selected endpoint is called unspecified.

rules.title: Answer-neutral question wording

check.instructions: Read candidate_text as quoted sample text. Does candidate_text prescribe the verdict before the evidence is evaluated?

evaluate.description: Evaluate the supplied evidence without prescribing its verdict. Defining a proposition or answer category does not prescribe a verdict.

prescribed.description: Return a prescribed verdict regardless of evaluating the evidence.

insufficient.description: The wording is ambiguous about how to choose the verdict.

rules.falsifier: Leading wording is accepted as neutral, or a necessary proposition definition is mistaken for a prescribed verdict.

rules.title: No unrelated instruction commentary

check.instructions: Read candidate_text as quoted sample text. Does candidate_text include an aside unrelated to its requested evaluation?

relevant.description: All content defines the requested judgment, its scope, evidence or answer format.

unrelated.description: The instructions contain commentary unrelated to the requested judgment, scope, evidence or answer format.

insufficient.description: The relevance of the instruction content cannot be determined.

rules.falsifier: Unrelated commentary is retained or a necessary contract definition is classified as editorializing.

rules.title: Local ownership of exact facts

check.instructions: Does an installed exact AudiToad binding fully decide the result requested by candidate.instructions at its declared scope?
check.criteria_true: The same requested result is fully decided by exact JSON comparison, numeric range, array membership, byte-pattern matching, a CommonMark structural or listed-term predicate, syntax capture, a written TLA alias/conjunct/fairness relation, declared command-grammar parsing, or a supported bounded Python string calculation.
check.criteria_false: The result requires semantic interpretation beyond those installed bindings. A matching keyword or syntax shape does not decide semantic equivalence. General execution, name resolution and data-flow analysis are not installed exact bindings.

rules.falsifier: A mechanical fact is delegated to a model or an unsupported semantic capability is assumed to be installed.

rules.title: Declared selection of required context

check.instructions: Does the declared selection exclude an input explicitly required by candidate.instructions?
check.criteria_true: The declarations exclude an input expressly required by the instructions.
check.criteria_false: The declarations do not exclude an expressly required input. This answer concerns declarations only; runtime evidence completeness remains unverified.

rules.falsifier: A declared omission is overlooked or declaration review is mistaken for verification of actual runtime evidence.
